component.name: NeuralCanvas
component.summary: Sketch interface layouts and turn them into wireframes

description.p: NeuralCanvas is a fast drawing canvas for people who think in boxes and arrows. Sketch a screen freehand with a mouse or a pen tablet, and NeuralCanvas recognises buttons, fields, cards, text, dividers, images and arrows, and shows them as a clean wireframe you can edit.

ul.li: An infinite canvas that keeps up with the pen, with pan, pinch and zoom that stay under your hand
Recognition that marks what it is unsure of, with a way to review each uncertain item
Wireframe styles taken from a screenshot of a real app: colours, corners and spacing, checked for contrast
Export as SVG, PDF, PNG and JPEG
Projects and sketches saved as you draw, on your computer only: no account and no network
